description: This file is a configuration include script for GCC, defining build options, environment variables, and compile-time configurations for a cross-compilation toolchain within a build system, likely BitBake. It sets parameters for languages, multilib configurations, thread support, and specific system headers, tailored for building a GCC compiler in an embedded Linux environment.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares the build environment for cross-compilation by setting environment variables, creating configuration files, and invoking the configuration script.
